problems.headline: motor 14 (thumb_abd) has latched electrical_shock at 30 °C
problems.advice: It still answers the bus and still acknowledges torque enable, but it will not move until it is rebooted or power-cycled. Cooling will not help — this is a supply or wiring fault, and it latches again on the next command until the cause is fixed. Check this motor's cable and connector at both ends, and the rail voltage while the motor is driven; the bit also means "insufficient power to operate the motor". Its steps were skipped, so it keeps its previous calibration.
